articles.title: Opportunity knocks as Red Sox open crucial four-game series with Yankees
articles.description: The last time the Red Sox faced the Yankees they completed a four-game sweep. They haven’t looked back since, and this weekend they’ll have a chance to finally catch their rivals in the standings.

articles.title: Red Sox shut out by Marlins, win streak snapped at five
articles.description: The Red Sox saw their five-game win streak snapped after getting shut out by the Marlins in Wednesday’s series finale.

articles.title: Jarren Duran hits grand slam in 11th inning to power Red Sox past Marlins
articles.description: Mickey Gasper homered twice and Jarren Duran broke things open with a grand slam in the 11th inning to power the Red Sox past the Marlins.

articles.title: Red Sox infielder inspired by memory of late college friend
articles.description: Caleb Durbin has shown a willingness to play through pain, but a messed up pinky is nothing compared to what the Red Sox third baseman once watched one of his closest friends battle through.

articles.title: Red Sox rally past Marlins to complete fourth straight comeback win
articles.description: The Red Sox rallied for their fourth consecutive comeback win on Monday, holding the Marlins to 2 for 18 with runners in scoring position in the process.

articles.title: Jake Bennett settles down, Red Sox rally to complete sweep of Giants
articles.description: The Red Sox pushed Jake Bennett’s start back to Sunday to give him some extra rest, and the move paid off as the rookie helped complete the sweep of the Giants.

articles.title: Worst-to-first: Red Sox offense sustaining remarkable turnaround
articles.description: Over the past two months the Red Sox have completely turned their season around, and a big part of how is the offense has gone from the worst in MLB to the one of the best.

articles.title: MLB notes: Revisiting Red Sox-Rafael Devers trade and its complex legacy
articles.description: The Rafael Devers trade has a complicated legacy, but have the Red Sox proven to be better off without him? A deep dive into that question and the trade’s lasting impact.

articles.title: Red Sox storm back with wild ninth inning to earn walk-off win over Giants
articles.description: The Red Sox showed their fight with a wild walk-off win over the Giants.

articles.title: Red Sox won’t ‘rule out’ injured stars returning during upcoming road trip
articles.description: Chad Tracy will not ‘rule out’ injured Red Sox stars returning during upcoming road trip

articles.title: Rafael Devers homers in return, but Red Sox rally past Giants in opener
articles.description: Rafael Devers homered in his first game back at Fenway Park, but the Red Sox rallied for five runs in the third inning to beat the Giants in Friday’s opener.

articles.title: Rafael Devers has no regrets about Red Sox tenure in return to Fenway
articles.description: Rafael Devers heard boos and cheers Friday night in his return to Fenway Park, and said he has no regrets about the end of his Red Sox tenure.

articles.title: From Venezuela to ‘SpongeBob,’ Red Sox embracing Player’s Weekend fun
articles.description: Whether it’s their home country, a meaningful cause or SpongeBob SquarePants, the Red Sox are having fun expressing themselves this MLB Players’ Weekend.

articles.title: Red Sox manager provides update on Roman Anthony, Trevor Story’s next steps
articles.description: What’s the plan for Trevor Story, Roman Anthony and others? Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy laid out their next steps through the end of the weekend.

articles.title: Red Sox prospect, former Belmont Hill star turning heads in Portland
articles.description: A homegrown kid who starred at Belmont Hill, Jack Winnay has emerged as one of the most intriguing hitters in the Red Sox farm system.

articles.title: Red Sox slugger downplays dustup with fan: ‘He was inviting me to dinner’
articles.description: For the second time in less than a month Willson Contreras was booed for not running out a ground ball, which this time also led to an argument between the Red Sox slugger and a fan.
